title: Where the team is
description: Where the team works from: a world map with the team's countries in red, a flag chip for each, and the country count in the headline, all from one comma-separated list. The default list is the countries on the Welcome to Massive cards, only part of the team. Source: public/image-projects/welcome-* (each card's country field).

fields.label: Countries
fields.default: Ukraine, Poland, Italy, Brazil, Finland, Canada, USA, Nigeria
fields.hint: Every country the team works from, comma-separated, in English; 1 to 25, each one a chip and a red country.

fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: {N} becomes the number of countries, in red; up to two lines.
